headline: 《蜘蛛侠》领跑热搜，影市热度不减
headlineEn: Spider-Man leads hot search, box office heat continues
summary: 今日（8月10日）暂无新片上映，本周共有5部新片。当前热搜由《最后孤屋》《蜘蛛侠：崭新之日》等领跑，《蜘蛛侠：崭新之日》同样领衔本周热度；后续《最后的日出》《逃出绝命街》即将上映。
summaryEn: No new releases today (Aug 10); 5 films opened this week. Today's trending is led by The Last Lonely House and Spider-Man: Brand New Day, which also tops the weekly chart; upcoming titles include The Last Sunrise and Escape from Deadly Street.

industryHighlights.text: 本周共有5部新片与观众见面
industryHighlights.en: Five new films hit theaters this week

industryHighlights.text: 《蜘蛛侠：崭新之日》蝉联本周热搜冠军
industryHighlights.en: Spider-Man: Brand New Day tops the weekly trending chart

industryHighlights.text: 《最后的日出》《逃出绝命街》定档待映
industryHighlights.en: The Last Sunrise and Escape from Deadly Street are upcoming releases
